Subject: Clarification regarding RFQ for Corrugated Boxes - FY2026-27

Dear Om Sai Box Works team,

Thank you for your response to our RFQ for the FY2026-27 annual rate contract. To proceed with our review, please provide clarification on the following points:

1. Could you please provide the pricing for line 26 (Promo gift-pack outer, 450x350x250 mm, 5-ply), line 28 (Export edible oil 15L tin x 2 carton, 620x330x400 mm, 7-ply), and line 29 (Pallet-load spice drum outer, 580x400x450 mm, 7-ply), or confirm if you are not bidding for these items?
2. Could you please confirm the freight cost per box to our Chakan MIDC plant for 3-ply, 5-ply, and 7-ply boxes, or confirm that your quoted rates are on a delivered (FOR Chakan) basis?
3. Could you please re-send or confirm the price for line 14, as it is not legible in the document provided?
4. Could you please complete the quality questionnaire and attach your ISO 9001 certificate along with a recent bursting-strength test report?

We look forward to receiving these details at your earliest convenience.

Regards,

Category Buyer, Sahyadri Consumer Products Ltd, Chakan MIDC, Pune
